data.one_liner: Background geolocation SDK for Flutter with tracking, geofencing, activity recognition and HTTP sync
data.what_it_does: Provides continuous background location updates, activity detection, geofencing (circular and polygon), privacy zones, trip detection, and optional HTTP sync. Data is persisted locally in SQLite and can be queried with native filtering and pagination.
use_when: You need reliable background location tracking on Android and iOS
You require geofencing with enter/exit/dwell events
You want activity recognition (walking, running, driving)
You need to sync location data to a backend with retry and batching
avoid_when: You only need simple foreground location updates
You are building a web or desktop app
You prefer a lightweight package without native code
strengths: Full test suite and production-ready tooling
Supports polygon geofences and privacy zones
Built-in HTTP sync with retry and batching
weaknesses: Large plugin footprint due to native code
data.setup_notes: Add permissions in AndroidManifest and Info.plist, run `dart run locus:setup` for native config, initialize with `Locus.ready()` before starting tracking

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simpler foreground tracking without native background support

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides map UI but not background tracking or geofencing
